The separate scoped OAuth endpoint allows owner-delegated execution without changing ordinary workspace MCP authority; client confirmation is not recorded as independent human approval. Direct authenticated RPC writes remain denied. Automatic import of remaining source layouts is still separate work on the linked claim. Committed publication changes and exact retries refresh the public tag and root layout through the shared writer; a cache-host failure preserves the immutable receipt and leaves the existing public revalidation window as recovery.
